meaning_en: to get a chance to speak when others talk a lot
example_en: He talks so much, I can never get a word in edgeways.
examples_extra: He talked so fast that I couldn't get a word in edgeways.
She chatters non-stop, so nobody gets a word in edgeways.
note_fa: «وقتی کسی آن‌قدر حرف می‌زند که نوبت صحبت به تو نمی‌رسد.»

meaning_en: in a difficult or bad situation
example_en: My car broke down, so I'm in a real fix.
examples_extra: I'm in a fix — my car broke down and I'm late.
He was in a fix after losing his passport abroad.
note_fa: «یعنی در وضعیت سخت گیر کرده‌ای؛ هم‌معنی be in a tight corner.»

meaning_en: completely, totally, or definitely
example_en: "Are you sure?" "Absolutely!"
examples_extra: Absolutely! I'd love to come with you.
The water in the lake was absolutely freezing.

meaning_en: used to emphasize what is true or real
example_en: I thought it was easy, but actually it was hard.
examples_extra: She looks young, but she is actually forty.
Did it actually rain, or was it just cloudy?
note_fa: «یعنی «در واقع» نه «الان»؛ false friend معروف برای فارسی‌زبانان.»

meaning_en: to have the same opinion
example_en: Yes, I agree with you.
examples_extra: I completely agree with everything you just said.
They finally agreed to meet at six o'clock.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: I agree نه I am agree.

meaning_en: In an angry way.
example_en: She shouted angrily at her brother.
examples_extra: 'Leave me alone!' she shouted angrily at him.
He slammed the door angrily and left.
note_fa: قید حالت؛ معمولاً بعد از فعل.

meaning_en: A feeling of slight anger or irritation.
example_en: His constant talking caused me great annoyance.
examples_extra: The constant noise from the street was a real annoyance for us.
To her annoyance, the train left two minutes before she arrived.
note_fa: در کتاب در کنار irritation و disruption به‌عنوان اسمِ مشکل آمده.

meaning_en: To reply to a question or call.
example_en: Please answer my question.
examples_extra: She picked up the phone and answered it quickly.
He did not know how to answer the teacher's difficult question.
note_fa: در کتاب با تلفن: answer the phone (جواب دادن).

meaning_en: In a worried or nervous way.
example_en: She waited anxiously for the results.
examples_extra: She waited anxiously for the doctor to call with the results.
'Is everyone all right?' he asked them anxiously.
note_fa: در کتاب با افعال گفتن: said anxiously (با نگرانی گفت).

meaning_en: Used to change the subject or end a conversation.
meaning_fa: به هر حال، در هر صورت
example_en: It's late, I should go anyway.
examples_extra: It was raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
Anyway, as I was saying, the film starts at eight.
note_fa: دو کاربرد در کتاب: عوض کردن موضوع و «به هر حال».

meaning_en: To speak angrily because you disagree.
meaning_fa: بحث کردن، جر و بحث کردن
example_en: My brothers often argue about video games.
examples_extra: They often argue about small things, but they are good friends.
Please don't argue with your brother in front of the guests.
note_fa: در کتاب: argue یعنی have an angry discussion.

meaning_en: In many directions; in a circle.
example_en: We walked around the park.
examples_extra: We walked around the lake in the early morning.
I'll meet you at around six o'clock outside the cinema.
note_fa: در کتاب: around یعنی about یا approximately (تقریباً).

meaning_en: To say something to get information.
example_en: I will ask my teacher a question.
examples_extra: Can I ask you a question about your job?
She asked the teacher for help with her homework.
note_fa: ask for یعنی «درخواست کردن»؛ ask تنها یعنی «پرسیدن».

meaning_en: To inquire what time it is.
example_en: I asked a stranger the time.
examples_extra: Excuse me, can I ask you the time?
He asked a stranger the time at the bus stop.
note_fa: مؤدبانه‌تر: Could you tell me the time, please?

meaning_en: To ask for directions to a place.
example_en: We asked a local the way to the museum.
examples_extra: We asked a shopkeeper the way to the museum.
Can you ask someone the way to the station?

meaning_en: To request something.
example_en: I will ask for a glass of water.
examples_extra: The child asked for a glass of water.
She asked for permission to leave the class early.
note_fa: بعد از for همیشه اسم می‌آید، نه فعل.

meaning_en: To request an item or help from a person.
example_en: I will ask my mom for money.
examples_extra: She asked her best friend for some good advice.
He asked his teacher for extra time on the test.

meaning_en: To tell someone to perform an action.
meaning_fa: از کسی خواستن کاری انجام دهد
example_en: I asked him to close the door.
examples_extra: She asked him to open the window quietly.
The teacher asked us to read the first chapter.

meaning_en: Seriously or severely affected.
example_en: The economy was badly affected by the crisis.
examples_extra: The coastal towns were badly affected by the terrible winter storm.
Small businesses were badly affected when the factory suddenly closed.

meaning_en: Pay attention to avoid danger or mistakes.
example_en: Be careful when you cross the road.
examples_extra: Be careful! There is a car coming round the corner.
Be careful what you say to her; she is upset.

meaning_en: Ask for something in a very strong way.
example_en: The child begged for a new toy.
examples_extra: The child begged his mother to buy the toy.
They begged the manager for more time to finish.
note_fa: گذشته: begged؛ کالوکیشن کتاب: beg sb to do sth.

meaning_en: In a very unhappy or angry way.
example_en: She cried bitterly after hearing the news.
examples_extra: She wept bitterly when she heard the sad news.
He complained bitterly about the long delay at the airport.
note_fa: کتاب آن را کنار angrily برای نقل گفتار آورده.

meaning_en: What you say when someone sneezes.
example_en: "Achoo!" "Bless you!"
examples_extra: Bless you! I hope you are not catching a cold.
When he sneezed twice, she said, Bless you.
note_fa: وقتی کسی عطسه می‌کند می‌گویند: Bless you!

meaning_en: Talk proudly about what you have or can do.
example_en: He always boasts about his new car.
examples_extra: He boasted about his new car to everyone.
She never boasts about her own success at work.
note_fa: boast about something — با about می‌آید.

meaning_en: To injure a bone in your body.
example_en: He fell and broke his arm during the game.
examples_extra: She fell badly and broke her left leg.
Be very careful not to break the glass vase.

meaning_en: End an argument and become friends again.
example_en: After years of fighting, they decided to bury the hatchet.
examples_extra: After years of fighting, they finally buried the hatchet.
It is time to bury the hatchet and work together.
note_fa: یعنی آشتی کردن بعد از دعوا.

meaning_en: Feel too tired or upset to do something.
example_en: I can't face the thought of cooking dinner tonight.
examples_extra: I can’t face the thought of clearing up all this mess today.
She can’t face the thought of moving to a new city alone.
note_fa: یعنی اصلاً دلش نمی‌خواهد با چیزی روبه‌رو شود.

meaning_en: To be completely honest about your intentions.
meaning_fa: رو راست بودن، همه چیز را گفتن
example_en: Let's put our cards on the table and discuss this openly.
examples_extra: I thought it best to lay my cards on the table and be honest.
He laid his cards on the table and told them exactly what he wanted.
note_fa: اصطلاح lay your cards on the table یعنی صریح و بدون پرده حرف زدن.

meaning_en: A difficult task that tests your abilities.
example_en: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
examples_extra: Climbing the mountain was a real challenge.
She enjoys the challenge of learning new languages.

meaning_en: A state of complete disorder and confusion.
example_en: After the storm, there was total chaos.
examples_extra: The airport was in chaos after the flights were cancelled.
There was complete chaos in the classroom.

meaning_en: In a happy and positive way.
example_en: He waved cheerfully as he left.
examples_extra: 'Good morning!' she said cheerfully.
He cheerfully agreed to help us.

meaning_en: Used to say thank you or goodbye informally.
example_en: "Cheers for the help!" he said.
examples_extra: 'Cheers for your help!' she said.
Cheers! Have a great evening!

meaning_en: Said before drinking to wish good health.
example_en: "Cheers!" they said, raising their glasses.
examples_extra: They raised their glasses and said cheers.
'Cheers!' he said before taking a sip.
note_fa: به سلامتی؛ هنگام نوشیدن گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: An informal way to say goodbye.
example_en: "Right, I'm off. Cheers!"
examples_extra: 'Cheers, see you later!' he called.
She said cheers and left the office.

meaning_en: To fall down suddenly because of weakness or damage.
example_en: The old building might collapse in the storm.
examples_extra: The old wooden bridge collapsed in the storm.
The tall old building collapsed during the earthquake.
note_fa: فرو ریختن؛ هم برای ساختمان هم برای مذاکرات.

meaning_en: To say you are unhappy about something.
example_en: I need to complain about the service.
examples_extra: The guests complained about the noise.
She complained to the manager about the cold food.
note_fa: complain about نارضایتی / complain to شکایت به کسی.

meaning_en: To admit you did something wrong.
example_en: He confessed to eating the last cookie.
examples_extra: He finally confessed to stealing the money.
She confessed that she had broken the vase.
note_fa: confess to + ing: اعتراف به کاری.

meaning_en: Words said to praise someone for success.
example_en: Congratulations on your new job!
examples_extra: Congratulations on your new job!
Congratulations! You passed the exam!
note_fa: برای تولد نگو Congratulations؛ بگو Happy Birthday.

meaning_en: A street with no exit; a situation with no progress.
example_en: We reached a dead end in our investigation.
examples_extra: The talks reached a dead end after two days.
We drove down a dead end and had to turn back.
note_fa: بن‌بست؛ come to a dead end.

meaning_en: The state of not having basic necessities.
example_en: Many people suffer from sleep deprivation.
examples_extra: Children in the area suffer from severe deprivation.
Sleep deprivation can seriously harm your health.

meaning_en: To prevent someone from having something important.
example_en: Don't deprive yourself of a good night's sleep.
examples_extra: War deprives children of a normal childhood.
They deprived him of his freedom.
note_fa: الگو: deprive somebody of something (محروم کردن از).

meaning_en: With great urgency or strong need.
example_en: He desperately needed help to finish the project.
examples_extra: She desperately needed money for the operation.
They were desperately trying to finish on time.

meaning_en: A situation where you must choose between two difficult options.
example_en: I'm in a dilemma about which job to take.
examples_extra: He faced a dilemma: accept the new job or stay with his friends.
She was in a dilemma about whether to tell the truth.
note_fa: با face / be in می‌آید: «in a dilemma» یعنی دوراهی سخت.

meaning_en: A sudden event causing great damage or loss.
example_en: The earthquake was a terrible disaster.
examples_extra: The earthquake was a terrible disaster for the whole region.
The wedding was a complete disaster because of the rain.
note_fa: natural disaster یعنی بلای طبیعی؛ disastrous یعنی «فاجعه‌بار».

meaning_en: To stop something from continuing in a normal way.
example_en: Loud noises can disrupt a meeting easily.
examples_extra: The strike disrupted train services across the country.
Loud music from next door disrupted our evening.
note_fa: مختل کردن جریان عادی؛ disruption اسم آن است.

meaning_en: An interruption that stops something from continuing normally.
example_en: The storm caused a major disruption to flights.
examples_extra: The snow caused serious disruption to flights yesterday.
We apologise for the disruption to your journey.

meaning_en: In addition to something already mentioned.
example_en: Do you need anything else?
examples_extra: Do you want anything else from the shop?
Who else is coming to the party?
note_fa: else همیشه بعد از something/anything/nothing و who/where می‌آید.

meaning_en: Used to get someone's attention politely.
example_en: Excuse me, is this seat free?
examples_extra: Excuse me, could you tell me the time?
Excuse me, is this seat taken by anyone?
note_fa: برای جلب توجه یا عذرخواهی کوچک.

meaning_en: Used to politely get someone's attention.
example_en: Excuse me, can you help me?
examples_extra: Excuse me, where is the nearest pharmacy around here?
Excuse me, can you help me find this address?

meaning_en: A change that happens because of something else.
example_en: The new law had a big effect on the city.
examples_extra: The new law had a big effect on small businesses.
Regular exercise has a positive effect on health.
note_fa: اسم است؛ با فعل affect اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: An act of saying goodbye.
example_en: We said our farewells at the airport.
examples_extra: We held a farewell party for our teacher.
He waved farewell to his friends.

meaning_en: Belonging to the sex that can lay eggs or give birth.
example_en: This school has many female students.
examples_extra: The female lion hunts for food.
Female students joined the team.

meaning_en: in a very angry way.
example_en: He shouted furiously at them.
examples_extra: He typed furiously on his keyboard.
They argued furiously about the bill.

word: get to the bottom of things
meaning_en: Discover the real reason for something.
meaning_fa: ته و توی قضیه را درآوردن
example_en: We need to get to the bottom of this problem.
examples_extra: We need a full inquiry to get to the bottom of things.
The police are trying to get to the bottom of things.
note_fa: یعنی «ته قضیه را درآوردن»؛ غیررسمی است.

meaning_en: Talk about the most important thing directly.
example_en: Please get to the point; I'm busy.
examples_extra: Stop wasting time and get to the point.
Let him get to the point first.

meaning_en: Organize yourself and deal with problems effectively.
meaning_fa: خود را جمع و جور کردن
example_en: You need to get your act together and finish this project.
examples_extra: You need to get your act together before the exam.
The team finally got their act together.

meaning_en: Speak seriously to someone about their bad behavior.
example_en: His parents gave him a talking to about his grades.
examples_extra: The teacher gives him a talking to about his behaviour.
My dad gives me a real talking to.

meaning_en: With pleasure; willingly.
example_en: I would gladly help you with that.
examples_extra: I'll gladly help you with your homework.
She gladly accepted the invitation.

meaning_en: In a sad or depressed way.
example_en: He stared gloomily out the window.
examples_extra: He stared gloomily out of the window.
It will rain all week, she said gloomily.

meaning_en: A greeting used in the afternoon.
example_en: Good afternoon, how can I help you?
examples_extra: 'Good afternoon,' she said with a smile.
'Good afternoon, everyone!' he said.
note_fa: سلام عصرگاهی؛ بعد از ظهر گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: A greeting used in the evening.
example_en: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the show.
examples_extra: 'Good evening,' he said politely.
'Good evening, and welcome to the show!' she said.
note_fa: سلام شبانه؛ هنگام غروب و شب.

meaning_en: wishing someone success or a positive outcome.
example_en: Good luck with your exam!
examples_extra: 'Good luck with your exam!' she said.
'Good luck!' he shouted loudly.

meaning_en: a greeting used in the morning.
example_en: Good morning, how are you today?
examples_extra: 'Good morning,' she said cheerfully.
'Good morning, class!' said the teacher.

meaning_en: a word said when leaving someone.
example_en: Goodbye, see you tomorrow!
examples_extra: 'Goodbye! See you tomorrow!' she said.
He waved and said goodbye.

meaning_en: a greeting said when leaving at night or going to bed.
example_en: Goodnight, sleep well!
examples_extra: 'Goodnight! Sleep well!' she said.
He kissed the children and said goodnight.

meaning_en: to understand something completely.
example_en: I couldn't quite grasp the concept.
examples_extra: She quickly grasped the main idea.
He could not grasp what she meant.

meaning_en: to say hello to someone.
example_en: She greeted me with a warm smile.
examples_extra: She greeted us with a smile.
The host greeted every guest.

meaning_en: something you say or do to greet someone.
example_en: A simple greeting can make someone's day.
examples_extra: He gave me a warm greeting.
Greetings are important in every culture.

meaning_en: words or actions used to welcome someone.
example_en: He sent greetings to his family.
examples_extra: Send my greetings to your family.
They exchanged greetings at the door.

meaning_en: a deep sound showing pain or unhappiness.
example_en: He let out a groan of pain.
examples_extra: The old man groaned with pain when he stood up.
She gave a loud groan when she saw the long queue.
note_fa: آه از درد یا ناراحتی؛ moan مشابه است.

meaning_en: to complain in a quiet, unhappy way.
example_en: He always grumbles about the weather.
examples_extra: He always grumbles about the price of petrol.
The old neighbours grumbled over the noise next door.

meaning_en: In a happy way.
example_en: She smiled happily at the news.
examples_extra: They have been happily married for twenty years.
The children played happily in the garden.
note_fa: با خوشحالی؛ happily ever after پایان قصه‌هاست.

meaning_en: A greeting on someone's birthday.
example_en: Happy Birthday! I hope you have a great day.
examples_extra: Happy Birthday! I hope you have a wonderful day.
We all sang Happy Birthday when she blew out the candles.
note_fa: تولدت مبارک؛ با Congratulations قاطی نکنید.

meaning_en: A greeting during the Christmas season.
example_en: Happy Christmas to you and your family!
examples_extra: Happy Christmas! We hope you enjoy the holidays.
She sent cards saying Happy Christmas to all her friends.
note_fa: کریسمس مبارک؛ در آمریکا Merry Christmas رایج‌تر است.

meaning_en: A greeting at the start of a new year.
example_en: Happy New Year! I wish you all the best.
examples_extra: Happy New Year! Wishing you health and happiness.
At midnight everyone shouted Happy New Year together.
note_fa: سال نو مبارک؛ اول ژانویه گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: The organ that pumps blood.
example_en: Your heart beats all the time.
examples_extra: Daily exercise keeps your heart strong and healthy.
His excited heart was beating incredibly fast.
note_fa: قلب؛ learn by heart یعنی حفظ کردن.

meaning_en: Extreme sadness or emotional pain.
example_en: Losing her pet caused her great heartbreak.
examples_extra: The painful divorce caused her terrible heartbreak.
He never fully got over the heartbreak.

meaning_en: A greeting used when you meet someone.
example_en: Hello, how are you today?
examples_extra: Well, hello there! How are you doing today?
She said a warm hello and smiled at me.

meaning_en: A friendly greeting.
example_en: Hi, how are you?
examples_extra: Hi, how are you today?
She said hi and waved at me.

meaning_en: Used to express hope for something to happen.
example_en: Hopefully, the weather will be good tomorrow.
examples_extra: Hopefully, the weather will be nice tomorrow.
She waited hopefully for good news.

meaning_en: Used to ask someone the same question you were asked.
example_en: I like coffee. How about you?
examples_extra: I'm fine, thanks. How about you?
A: I love swimming. B: How about you?

meaning_en: Used to ask for an opinion or suggest something.
example_en: How about a new game?
examples_extra: How about a cup of tea?
How about going for a walk?

meaning_en: Used to suggest an idea or activity.
example_en: How about going to the cinema tonight?
examples_extra: How about meeting at six?
How about we order pizza tonight?

meaning_en: A friendly way to ask how someone is doing.
example_en: Hi, John! How are things?
examples_extra: Hi! How are things with you?
How are things at work?

meaning_en: A common greeting asking about someone's health or state.
example_en: Hello, how are you today?
examples_extra: Hello, how are you doing today?
How are you feeling today, my friend?

meaning_en: Used to ask for a word or phrase in another language.
example_en: How do you say "hello" in French?
examples_extra: How do you say 'book' in French?
How do you say this word?

meaning_en: An informal greeting asking how someone is doing.
example_en: Hey, Mark! How's it going?
examples_extra: Hi! How’s it going? Not bad, thanks.
How’s it going with the new job?

meaning_en: To move or do something faster.
example_en: Hurry up! The bus is coming.
examples_extra: Hurry up! The taxi is waiting.
We must hurry up to finish on time.

meaning_en: To have the same opinion as someone else.
example_en: "Let's go." "Yes, I agree."
examples_extra: I agree with you completely.
I agree, let's go by train.
note_fa: اشتباه رایج: نگو I am agree.

meaning_en: It doesn't matter to me; I have no preference.
example_en: "Tea or coffee?" "I don't mind."
examples_extra: I don't mind waiting a little.
Where shall we eat? I don't mind.

meaning_en: To demand something firmly.
example_en: She insisted that I stay for dinner.
examples_extra: She firmly insisted on paying for dinner.
He always insists that he is right.

meaning_en: Very strongly or with great feeling.
example_en: The noise was intensely annoying.
examples_extra: The constant loud noise was intensely annoying.
She felt intensely proud of her son.

meaning_en: To tell people each other's names.
example_en: Let me introduce you to my friend, Sarah.
examples_extra: Let me introduce you to my friend.
She introduced me to her parents.
note_fa: معرفی کردن افراد: introduce A to B.

meaning_en: Something that makes you annoyed or uncomfortable.
example_en: The constant noise was a real irritant.
examples_extra: Smoke is an irritant to the eyes.
Dust can be an irritant for allergy sufferers.

meaning_en: The feeling of being annoyed or uncomfortable.
example_en: He felt a growing irritation with the delay.
examples_extra: She couldn't hide her irritation.
The cream soothes skin irritation.

meaning_en: It is not important.
example_en: Don't worry about it, it doesn't matter.
examples_extra: It doesn't matter if you're late.
It doesn't matter to me.

meaning_en: You can decide.
example_en: What do you want to eat? It's up to you.
examples_extra: It's up to you where we eat.
You decide; it's up to you.

meaning_en: To not have enough of something.
example_en: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
examples_extra: They lack clean drinking water.
He lacks confidence in himself.

meaning_en: Used to suggest an action.
example_en: Let's go to the park.
examples_extra: Let's meet at the station at six o'clock.
Let's try that new Italian restaurant on Saturday.
note_fa: مخفف let us؛ برای پیشنهاد دادن.

word: light at the end of the tunnel
meaning_en: A sign of hope after a difficult period.
example_en: After many problems, we finally saw light at the end of the tunnel.
examples_extra: At last, there is light at the end of the tunnel.
The good results were light at the end of the tunnel.
note_fa: «امید پس از سختی»؛ نشانه پایان مشکلات.

meaning_en: using too many words in speaking or writing.
example_en: His long-winded speech bored everyone in the room.
examples_extra: His speech was too long-winded.
She gave a long-winded explanation.

meaning_en: warning someone to be careful or watch for danger.
example_en: Look out! There's a car coming!
examples_extra: Look out! A car is coming.
Look out for snakes on the path.
note_fa: هشدار: «مواظب باش!»؛ look out for یعنی مراقب بودن.

meaning_en: keep something in good condition.
example_en: It's important to maintain a healthy diet.
examples_extra: It is hard to maintain a healthy diet.
They maintain the garden beautifully.

meaning_en: Understand something confusing.
example_en: I can't make head or tail of these instructions.
examples_extra: I can't make head or tail of it.
She couldn't make head or tail of the letter.

meaning_en: Belonging to the sex that is not female.
example_en: There are more male students than female.
examples_extra: The male teachers are in room two.
A male lion has a mane.

meaning_en: A greeting used on Christmas Day.
example_en: We said "Merry Christmas" to everyone.
examples_extra: Merry Christmas to you all!
We say Merry Christmas on the 25th of December.

meaning_en: Slightly; not very strongly.
example_en: The noise was only mildly irritating.
examples_extra: He was mildly surprised by the news.
The food was mildly spicy.

meaning_en: In a very unhappy or bad way.
example_en: He failed the exam miserably.
examples_extra: The team failed miserably in the final match.
He sat miserably in the corner.

meaning_en: to confuse things or people
example_en: Don't muddle up the papers.
examples_extra: Please don't muddle up the two similar names.
I'm in a complete muddle about the dates.
note_fa: قاتی کردن؛ کتاب: be in a muddle یعنی گیج بودن.

meaning_en: to speak quietly and unclearly
meaning_fa: زیر لب حرف زدن، من و من کردن
example_en: He mumbled his answer, so I couldn't hear.
examples_extra: He quietly mumbled a quick apology and left.
She always mumbles quietly when she is nervous.
note_fa: زیر لب و نامفهوم حرف زدن؛ کتاب: soft and unclear.

meaning_en: Speak in a low, quiet voice.
example_en: She murmured something I couldn't hear.
examples_extra: She murmured something romantic in his ear.
